answer.rationale:
The two measured deficits this quarter are onboarding completion (-4%) and activation (-6%), and onboarding sits upstream of activation, so fixing the funnel entry has the widest leverage on the one slot available. memory_86 and memory_31 both support simplification, which is exactly why I want their source records pulled: they are the memories I would act on, they are the oldest in the set (day 12 and day 52), and their stated outcomes are activation/completion lifts rather than retained revenue. I need to see whether the original experiments ever tracked accounts past first-week activation or whether 'durable lift' was an inference from a proxy metric. Promotional pricing is the obvious reflex against a competitor's entry pricing and memory_73 shows the strongest headline numbers (+31% accounts, +18% booked revenue), but the same record shows renewals down 12 points at first term. Against an objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue, that is a direction that buys a good quarter and sells the year, and it would also meet the competitor on the axis where they have chosen to fight. Referral incentives (memory_57) are clean but operate on established customers and do nothing for the top-of-funnel decay actually observed. Enterprise sales-assist (memory_44) is credible but addresses a different segment than the one bleeding. Activation messaging (memory_91) is my fallback if verification undercuts the onboarding evidence.

Downstream risk I am explicitly flagging: reducing signup friction can raise activation counts while lowering the average quality of accounts admitted, so a completion lift can coexist with flat or worse qualified revenue. I will therefore run this as a standard experiment with retention and qualified-revenue-per-cohort as the judged endpoints, not completion rate, and I will not treat the inherited lifts as established for the long-term metric until the archive shows the horizon they were measured over. If the source records reveal short measurement windows or a shifted self-serve mix since day 52, I will downgrade to a small guarded test rather than proceed at standard scale.
